description: This source file defines the AuthorizedAnnotationAttributes class, which provides methods for retrieving and analyzing @Authorized annotations on classes, methods, and fields for authorization purposes within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: AuthorizedAnnotationAttributes
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to extract authorization attributes from classes, methods, and fields based on @Authorized annotations to support security configuration in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the collection of security attributes (privileges) from a class or method annotated with @Authorized.

methods.name: getRequireAll
methods.description: Determines if all specified privileges are required for authorization based on the @Authorized annotation attributes.

methods.name: hasAuthorizedAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if the given method is annotated with @Authorized.
